company.description: Amorphic Labs develops AI agents that create personalized product demonstration videos for sales and customer success teams. The service researches account and prospect context, adapts workflows and demonstration data, and navigates a connected application to record a walkthrough. It generates scripts, narration, captions, and shareable video outputs for pre-sales, active deals, onboarding, customer support, documentation, and internal knowledge sharing. Vendors can configure workflows, narration styles, sandbox environments, and connected applications through the service.
